category: set by the change alone
lit arc: changed lines no test ran
hairline: changed lines the tests ran
notch: a mutant no test killed
stitches: its tests passed, not run, failed
red bolt: a failing check names a changed file
grey bolt: fails on files the change left alone
ghost: usually changes with these, and did not
cyan: a changed file; +path in a row: added
skin lit whole: no coverage report names it
warm light: the reach, dimmer each module out
lit halo: where the reach leaves a module
hatching: how much of it was rewritten lately
stipple: how many of its commits fixed bugs
